prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Purpose: original buildable environment concept art for a premium survival game set in an abandoned, drowned subtropical coastal city several generations after people left. Invent solely from this written description. No photographs, no other game's imagery, no existing franchise designs.
Medium: polished digital PAINTING in stylized realism, high-end game art, confident designed forms, rich tactile materials, believable warm late-afternoon sunlight and cool sky fill in shadows. Handsome, restrained, specific. Not photoreal photography, not cartoon, not loose sketch.
Palm construction: every crown consists of distinct pinnate feather fronds with a visible midrib, many slim leaflets on both sides, a rising arch and drooping tip. Open wedges of sky between fronds; clear radial crown star. Never fan palms, banana leaves, fern blobs or fuzzy green balls. Individual trees vary in age, height, lean, crown fullness, missing fronds and minor scars. All crowns grow radially in 3D and work from every azimuth.
Royal: nearly straight smooth pale grey column, subtle swell below mid-height, taper toward a glossy bright green 1.5–2 m crownshaft, 3–4 m arching fronds, compact elevated crown; mature height 14–20 m, trunk about 0.5 m wide with 0.6 m swell. Coconut: slender grey-brown ringed trunk 9–14 m along its curve, 0.3–0.4 m wide, leaning outward then rising, occasional kink/S curve, broad loose 8–10 m crown of 4–5 m drooping fronds, coconuts and old flower stalks just under crown, 0–3 hanging dead brown fronds. Bases flare gently into very tight low mats of thin roots immediately around the trunk, never sprawling roots, buttresses or root stilts.
Output: one finished PNG, landscape canvas, maximum native resolution available; aim for 3840 x 2160. No watermark or decorative border.
Asset: grove_near.png. A beautiful immersive painted player's view standing at exactly 1.7 m eye height on the fractured boulevard of the abandoned subtropical bay city. Natural level horizon, moderately wide view, no fisheye, no overhead angle. Two palms close enough to walk up and chop: a pale grey royal trunk about 3 m from viewpoint left of center, and a slender leaning ringed coconut trunk about 6 m away on the right, curving toward a glimpse of turquoise bay. Both bases clear and approachable, small tight thin-root mats hugging cracked asphalt/sandy soil. Near trunk material beautifully legible, pale smooth royal versus warm ringed coconut, tactile sunlit scars. Crop the crown of the closest tall royal naturally ABOVE frame if eye-level geometry requires; never shrink a tree to fit a low camera.
At 8–15 m several complete royal and coconut palms visible with distinct crowns through openings; beyond, dozens more in broken boulevard rows and spontaneous groves. The road has weeds, sand, puddles, displaced paving and just the short corroded stumps of old lamp posts. A collapsed low concrete building on the left has one 16 m royal growing right through its open shattered roof/floor slab, trunk and broken roof contact visibly understandable. Remnants of low seawall and blue-green bay through the right-hand grove. Ruins remain quiet support to the trees. A single distant 1.8 m human explorer walking 20 m down the road supplies scale; no foreground hands, weapons or UI. A few low hammock plants but palm trunk access stays open.
Fronds are discrete countable arching feather leaves with dark underside, fresh green centers, weathered olive outer fronds, yellow lower tips, 1–2 dead brown fronds on some coconuts, fruits on one middle-distance tree. Emphasize three-dimensional radial crowns with gaps. Warm low sunlight gives long believable shadows across broken road, cool blue sky light in shade, rich but restrained green/grey/ochre palette. Premium finished game environment concept painting with readable large shape hierarchy and controlled detail. No text.
